# #361 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m361_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m361_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m361_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m361_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m361_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m361_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 361 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m361_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m361_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m361_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m361_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m361_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_adopt_charter_361
				has_variable = zg361_we_m361_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m361_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_al_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_al_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_al_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_al_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m361_write_owner = var:zg361_case_al_owner
			var:zg361_we_m361_write_subject = var:zg361_case_al_subject
			var:zg361_we_m361_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m361_write_case = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m361_write_state = var:zg361_case_al_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m361_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_object_charter_version
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_resource_charter
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_resource_gold
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_resource_policy_defaults
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_resource_history
						has_variable = zg361_we_m361_object_due_cycle
						}
					var:zg361_we_m361_object_type_code = 361
					var:zg361_we_m361_consumer_contract = 361
					var:zg361_we_m361_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m361_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m361_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m361_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m361_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m361_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m361_object_case = var:zg361_we_m361_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m361_object_state = var:zg361_we_m361_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}

	}

		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 3613 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED, no receipt or business write
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_al_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_al_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_al_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_al_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_al_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
			}
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
				RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
				RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
				RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
				RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
				RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
				RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
				EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_al_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_al_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_al_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_al_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_al_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
			}
			OR = {
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 5
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 5
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 5
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 3619 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # route collision typed RED
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
